summary: Frontend-only verification of admin 'Login Security' panel. All 5 requested scenarios PASS: (1) nav item visible to admin, (2) AdminRoute redirects staff away from /login-security back to '/', (3) seeded locked row for seeddemo@example.com renders with IP 127.0.0.1, fails=5, red 'Locked until ...' badge, Refresh button present, (4) after 3 wrong logins for paneldemo@example.com, admin Refresh shows new row with fails=3 and 'Not locked' badge, (5) Unlock on seeddemo triggers success toast 'Unlocked seeddemo@example.com' and the row is removed after auto-refresh. Nav gating: staff sees 0 'Login Security' links; /login-security manually redirects staff to '/'. All data-testids (login-security-page, login-security-refresh, login-attempt-row-*, login-attempt-status-*, login-attempt-unlock-*) resolve correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginSecurityPage row key uses r.key directly in data-testid (e.g., login-attempt-row-127.0.0.1:seeddemo@example.com). Colons/dots in testids are fine but avoid if key ever contains spaces/slashes.
unlock() sets state after await load(); if component unmounts during unlock, would warn. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login Security admin UI fully verified. Sidebar user-menu trigger in AppSidebar footer lacks explicit data-testid; the last button with lucide-chevrons-up-down svg is the correct target (first is area-switcher-trigger). Admin username field accepts 'admin' (not email). Row key format is '<ip>:<identifier>'.
